A-camp-camp-0043.recDirections: From Merritt, the best way to get to Glimpse Lake is to travel east along Highway 5A past Quilchena on Nicola Lake. Exit onto Douglas Lake Road and travel approximately 7 km until reaching the intersection with Lauder Rd just past the hydro station. Turn left on to Lauder Rd and travel approximately 14 km to get to the Glimpse Lake Southwest site. Turn right at the cattle guard.Follow this road in for a kilometre. Be careful as the road is a bit narrow in spots for longer rigs.
